title: Just Do Blood to One Hospital: Zipline's First Months in Muhanga
conflicts: Hospitals served after launch: Rinaudo Cliffton (Wilson Quarterly 2024 and First Round podcast) says one hospital for the first nine months; Daily Maverick at the launch (18 Oct 2016) reported two of 21 planned clinics. The story gives his figure as his and notes the contemporary count of two. Child share of transfusions: he says 30%, Reuters 2016 says about a third; the story uses his 30%. Launch timing: Reuters reports a demo on 13 Oct and a photo caption deliveries on 12 Oct; the story uses the 14 Oct launch with Kagame given by AFP and Daily Maverick. He recalls launching 3-6 months after signing; the framework agreement was reported in February 2016, so the story gives only the month.
notes: Quotes 'a complete disaster' and the fishing-pole/launcher details come from an auto-generated podcast transcript (rosetta.to); the details are corroborated by DroneXL's report of Zipline's own film. The minister's words are quoted only from the edited Wilson Quarterly text. Study figures (79 minutes faster, 67% fewer expirations) are from the 2022 Lancet Global Health paper via HTN and an abstract record; Zipline's own 51% maternal-mortality claim is not used. This is the one edition in my group that mentions talQen.
